paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Number of tasks by language family.
model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of morphosyntactic tasks associated with different language families, as presented in the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models." The vertical axis lists the language families in descending order of the number of tasks, starting with "IE-Slavic" at the top and ending with "Basque" at the bottom. The horizontal axis, labeled "# tasks," represents the count of tasks on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each bar corresponds to a language family and is color-coded for visual distinction: "IE-Slavic" (light blue) has the longest bar, indicating approximately 78 tasks; "IE-Romance" (dark blue) follows with about 47 tasks; "IE-Germanic" (light green) has around 43 tasks; "Uralic" (green) has approximately 19 tasks; "IE-Baltic" (pink) has about 18 tasks; "IE-other" (red) has roughly 15 tasks; "IE-Indic" (beige) has approximately 12 tasks; "Semitic" (orange) has about 9 tasks; "Turkic" (lavender) has around 6 tasks; and "Basque" (purple) has the shortest bar, indicating approximately 4 tasks. The bars are arranged in descending order of task count, and there are no annotations or special visual emphasis on any particular bar.
